title: Earnings Share and Trip Fee Offset on a Vehicle Protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan
content:
The plan a host holds under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan decides what the host keeps of every trip on that vehicle, and the share is applied to the trip price before any overage or fee the guest also pays is shared.

### The trade the ladder makes

Better cover is bought with a smaller share, so a host moving to a plan with more protection keeps less of each trip, and the marketplace never offers both the larger share and the larger cover.

### The trip fee offset

Where a plan carries a trip fee offset the host is credited that share of the marketplace trip fee as well, posted to the payout account as its own entry rather than folded into the trip earning.

### Roadside callouts on a vehicle that carries both

Where the same vehicle is covered by an active Keyturn Roadside Assistance subscription as well as a plan that already includes roadside assistance, the roadside callouts included in the protection plan are used first and the subscription's own allowance is only drawn on once they are exhausted.

### A change of plan is never retrospective

A share is never applied retrospectively, so a plan change that takes effect mid-month leaves trips before the effective date on the old share and trips after it on the new one.

### Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A trip runs wholly before the effective day of a plan change | The old plan governs | The host keeps the old plan's share of that trip. |
| A trip runs wholly after that day | The new plan governs | The host keeps the new plan's share. |
| The plan carries a trip fee offset | The offset stands as its own credit | It is posted to the payout account separately from the trip earning. |
